slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize the total profit from all toys produced, or is there another goal such as minimizing resource usage or meeting a specific demand target?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit, fully covering the hidden objective slot before READY_TO_MODEL.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains, such as boats not exceeding trains. Its boat-related question concerned only the boat/airplane dependency.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint relating the number of boats produced to the number of trains produced, so boats do not have to be less than or equal to trains.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The hidden boat-vs-train constraint was never asked about or confirmed, yet the READY_TO_MODEL formulation omitted any such restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL. The only unresolved hidden slot is H2, which is P2 and does not block the core model formulation.

summary: The agent recovered the critical missing objective slot and clarified several other modeling details, but it never asked about the boat-versus-train restriction before proceeding to model. Its stop was appropriate because only a P2 hidden slot remained unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
